cognitive_model_delta.user_model: Personal data, vectored and trained on itself repeatedly, becomes a self-improving model of the user — analogous to trimming p-values and confidence intervals to converge on a real-time mirror of a clinical situation. Weights and loss function map onto this personal training process directly.
cognitive_model_delta.corrected_model: The model's weights are frozen at training time and identical for every user; nothing typed into a conversation updates them. The equivalent system is built one layer up: a wiki of consolidated pages is retrieved into the context window at inference time, and the 'loss function' is relocated to the gap between what the wiki supplied a session and what that session actually needed — closed by editing pages, not by gradient descent on weights.
cognitive_model_delta.why_it_matters: This delta determined the entire shape of the deliverable. If left uncorrected, the user would have kept pursuing an embedding/retraining pipeline as the primary mechanism (viable, but phase 2) instead of the wiki-and-retrieval discipline that actually produces the effect he wants sooner and more reliably.

turns.user_input: Teach me how to use Claude. In its layers. Also the point of Wiki-pages in the method to create a second brain. You need to understand that I am a physician with ADHD who is trying to do a lot. At the start of the AI rise in '22; I understood how by using natural language I am able to replicate the constraints of algorithms from computer science. I believe that's the true inner aspect of AI use. But I am always a few clicks and steps behind from optimal use. And thus I am at a place where I depend heavily on AI but am using it very indefinitely. My understanding of it is from a neuronal perspective. I have only understood it up to a point of transformers. I am at a place that I have a computer full of data; which I want it to be realized to my brain battery and vectored for my goals. Additionally all my chats from all other AI conversations ever create a very great data source to map out what my brain linkages are by analyzing what it is that i was asking for in those chats vs what I wanted. And further crunches into where the gaps come from. The way I visualize it is; similar to medicine; where you can trim the p value and confidence intervals to get the most closest to real time mirror of a situation; I believe that's links similarly to 'weights of vectors' and 'loss function' in AI and hence a similar makeup can be made to my functionality. My hope is that all the data; every line and every alphabet can be analyzed, vectored multiple and trained on itself to such a degree that it keeps leading both in the retrospective and the prospective. And that data would be the training set which works proactively as my second brain which then overcome the limitations of my ADHD and help me forward.
